limitations: Single local macOS arm64 optimized component measurement; not a cross-platform guarantee.
Measures warm edits and repeated target cache hits; excludes cold startup, native UI interaction latency and idle rendering.
Uncontrolled host activity may affect timing; deterministic cache and bounded-work tests remain the regression contract.
Enabling rainbow brackets has measurable linear per-edit work; palette-only changes reuse cached syntax.
